pairs: The Lord is great in Zion,
and he is high above all peoples.
May they confess to your great name,
for it is terrible and holy.
And the honor of the king loves judgment.
judicium et justitiam in Jacob tu fecisti.
You have accomplished judgment and justice in Jacob.
and adore the footstool of his feet,
Moyses et Aaron in sacerdotibus ejus,
Moses and Aaron are among his priests,
et Samuel inter eos qui invocant nomen ejus:
and Samuel is among those who call upon his name.
in columna nubis loquebatur ad eos.
He spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.
and the precept that he gave them.
You were a forgiving God to them,
et ulciscens in omnes adinventiones eorum.
though taking vengeance on all their inventions.
et adorate in monte sancto ejus,
and adore on his holy mountain.
For the Lord our God is holy.
